topic: SBI Group capital, Circle/Ripple distribution, retail XRP channels and enterprise AI relationships

circle_ipo_equity_investment.interpretation: Actual equity capital invested in Circle; not XRP capital and not the same as the Circle SBI Japan JV.

circle_sbi_japan_jv.purpose: USDC distribution and digital-currency services in Japan
circle_sbi_japan_jv.ownership: 50:50 according to Circle/SBI corporate disclosures and prior filings

rlusd_japan_listing.japan_classification: SBI VC Trade's own legal interpretation treated RLUSD as a No.4 electronic payment instrument under Japanese law; do not generalize this as a US legal classification.

crypto_card.feature: Points earned on purchases can be automatically converted into BTC, ETH or XRP.
crypto_card.interpretation: A real retail distribution mechanism with XRP as an option; not proof of meaningful XRP net buying or user selection share.

openai.rollout: SBI Securities Jan 2025; selected SBI Holdings employees Mar 2025

anthropic.scope: Claude rollout across group, security features, priority access, roadmap sharing, engineering support and co-development of financial AI agents

sbigroup_ai.boundary: These are SBI Group's enterprise relationships. They do not establish that SBIC East Japan is an affiliate, that Barrot is connected to these platforms, or that SBI has connected ChatGPT/Claude to XRP prediction systems.

sbic_separation.entity: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (SBIC East Japan)
sbic_separation.shareholders: Local governments, chambers of commerce, financial institutions and operating companies, per official profile
sbic_separation.chatgpt_activity: Official seminars/training include ChatGPT/generative-AI education, including 2026-03-05 event with Microsoft Japan speaker
sbic_separation.relationship_to_sbi_holdings: No ownership/control relationship established in reviewed primary sources; treat as separate entity.

confirmed_edges: SBI Holdings/SBI Shinsei -> Circle: $50M total strategic equity investment in Circle IPO, split $25M each.
SBI Holdings -> Circle: 50:50 Circle SBI Japan JV and USDC distribution through SBI VC Trade.
SBI Group -> Ripple: RLUSD listing/distribution through SBI VC Trade.
SBI VC Trade/Aplus/Visa -> XRP: card points may be converted into XRP.
SBI Holdings -> OpenAI: ChatGPT Enterprise rollout.
SBI Holdings -> Anthropic: group-wide Claude AI transformation agreement.
SBIC East Japan -> ChatGPT: educational seminars, not an enterprise partnership.
network_interpretation.inference: SBI Group is building a multi-stablecoin and multi-model enterprise ecosystem: USDC, RLUSD, XRP reward option, ChatGPT Enterprise and Claude. This is a strategic distribution and technology footprint, not evidence of an exclusive XRP strategy.
unknowns: USDC/RLUSD net volume and user balances at SBI VC Trade
XRP share of SBI Crypto Card point redemptions
actual XRP spot purchases attributable to the card or voucher programs
whether SBI Group uses any of the nine AI platforms in a Barrot-like prediction workflow
any ownership or control link between SBIC East Japan and SBI Holdings
